messages:
jess_support: Hey team — customer ACME reports lots of requests getting routed to EU which is adding ~500-800ms and also inflating their billing. They say our SDK is sending an empty X-Client-Region header while their app sets region=us-west. Example from their logs (redacted):

acme_ops: ```
Request-ID: req_123abc
GET /v1/generate?region=us-west
Headers:
  Authorization: REDACTED
  X-Client-Region: ""
  User-Agent: acme-sdk/2.1.0
```

jess_support: They say this started after upgrading to our 2.1.0 SDK. Can infra/eng reproduce and advise workaround?

mike_infra: Can repro quickly with a curl that sends an empty header. Triage question: do we treat an empty header as present (and thus higher precedence) or ignore it?

ana_engineering: quick note: router currently picks region from (1) query param, (2) X-Client-Region header, (3) default mapping. But because our header-parsing code treats a header with zero-length value as a present value (""), it ends up taking the header branch, then downstream code maps empty -> fallback "eu". So empty header beats explicit query param because of a bug in precedence logic.

ana_engineering: Repro steps I used:
```bash
curl -H "X-Client-Region:" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?region=us-west" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -v
# -> routed to eu-edge, see longer latency
```

mike_infra: Filed incident tracker IR-2026-345 and assigned to eng-runtime. Putting initial priority P1 because it affects routing + billing.

ana_engineering: Root cause: header parsing returns list of values; we had a truthy check `if (headerValues.length) { use headerValues[0]; }` which treats [''] as length>0. Proposed fix: normalize header value: `const v = headerValues[0]?.trim(); if (!v) { treat as absent }`. Also add unit + e2e for SDK + router combos. Patch in PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/PR-789 (internal).

jess_support: Customer asks for immediate mitigation and refund for 48h of cross-region egress. Can billing own the refund while eng fixes?

billing_bot: BILL-4521 created and assigned to billing-team. Please add ACME account id to the ticket — billing will validate usage and process partial refund if confirmed.

ana_engineering: Short-term workaround for ACME: have them explicitly set region in request body or query param AND remove the empty X-Client-Region header. SDK fix: we will cut a patch that stops sending empty header values (SDK v2.1.1).

acme_ops: Confirmed removing the header made requests route correctly to us-west and latencies dropped back to ~40ms. We can hold on refunds until billing confirms. Thanks.

mike_infra: Deployment plan: canary to eu-edge tonight 02:00 UTC (5% traffic), monitor routing metrics and token billing counters for ACME; full rollout after 1hr stable. Rollback plan included in PR.

ana_engineering: I'll push the minimal router guard and tests to PR-789. Also adding a logging metric for "header-empty-precedence" so we can find other customers affected.

jess_support: Actions for support: (1) Confirm workaround applied with ACME (done), (2) link billing ticket to this thread (BILL-4521), (3) update ACME when patch is live.

mike_infra: Noted. Closing internal loop once PR merged and canary is green.

jess_support: Great — thanks everyone. ACME, we'll follow up when the SDK patch and router fix are rolled out. :thumbsup:
